title: Draw Shapes
text: Draw rectangles, lines, polygons, or circles on images, 7 inputs, 1 output, {Shape} sets Shape to draw; {Fill shapes}, {Line width}, {Fill color source} sets the input source to specify fill color Specify via, {Fill color} sets the color to fill, {Border color source} sets the input source to specify border color Specify via, {Border color} sets the outline color, {Color value(s)} sets the color value to draw the border or fill the shape, {Opacity factor (between 0 and 1)} sets the opacity of the color value in the range, {Use antialiasing} sets the smoothing algorithm, {Draw shapes in} sets the region to draw the shape and {Image signal} sets the number of input ports for the image signal One multidimensional. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: Input image or video stream M -by- N matrix of intensity values | M -by- N -by- 3 array of color values

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red color channel of the image or video frame M -by- N matrix

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green color channel of the image or video frame M -by- N matrix

ports.name: B
ports.summary: Blue color channel of the image or video frame M -by- N matrix

ports.name: Pts
ports.summary: Shape coordinates M -by-3 matrix | M -by-4 matrix | M -by-2 L matrix

ports.name: Clr
ports.summary: Color of shape 3-element vector | M -by- 3 matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output image M -by- N matrix of intensity values | M -by- N -by- 3 array of color values

params.name: Shape
params.values: Shape to draw Rectangles (default) | Lines | Polygons | Circles

params.name: Fill shapes
params.values: Fill shapes with color off (default) | on

params.name: Line width
params.values: Line width for the shapes 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Fill color source
params.values: Input source to specify fill color Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Fill color
params.values: Color to fill the shapes Black (default) | White | User-specified value

params.name: Border color source
params.values: Input source to specify border color Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Border color
params.values: Outline color of the shape Black (default) | White | User-specified value

params.name: Color value(s)
params.values: Color value to draw the border or fill the shape scalar | 3-element vector

params.name: Opacity factor (between 0 and 1)
params.values: Opacity of the color value in the range [0,1] | R -element vector

params.name: Draw shapes in
params.values: Region to draw the shape Entire image (default) | Specify region of interest via port

params.name: Image signal
params.values: Number of input ports for the image signal One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals
